newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips rise slightly, Nasdaq stays down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips rise slightly, Nasdaq stays down.

text.p: The Dow industrials were narrowly higher in afternoon trading Monday but tech stocks were sluggish as markets awaited International Business Machines Corp's earnings report and a speech on Tuesday by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up six points at 7896, above session lows of 7840. But breadth on both the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq was negative.
The Nasdaq composite, whose technology stocks dragged broader equities markets lower on Friday, remained soft. It was down 11 points at 1537.
